laptops.summary: Built two features in separate worktrees: retro 8-bit Web Audio sound effects (yazan/sounds, chosen between two subagent-made styles) and a chaser drone that follows the player (yazan/chaser). Merged both plus Ruth's dark/light mode and Ahmad's pause and high score into main, resolving conflicts in game.js, settings.js and index.html, and pushed d0184f9. Combined game checked headless (no JS errors, pause, theme and chaser present); a full hand play-through is still to confirm.
laptops.notes: The sounds session's log was not found under ~/.claude/projects, so it is missing from the timeline. The yazan-main session also wrote this report; its intervals are cut at report time.
